description: This file contains the implementation of the function LVC_Mixer_SetTarget, which updates private instance parameters related to audio gain control, including Shift, Target, and Current, based on a new TargetGain value. It is part of an audio effects library for media processing.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_SetTarget
methods.description: Updates the Shift, Target, and Current gain parameters of an audio stream instance based on a new TargetGain value in Q16.15 format.
